$Comment: The Reindeer Suit's costume: for thirty minutes the wearer takes the game's Christmas reindeer look (the model Reindeer_Christmas, a stag with a red nose), the look the Christmas Wand lends another player for three minutes (Christmas_Costume_Reindeer). It changes the model and is no debuff, which is what makes it a costume: the wearer can take it off any time with /zigcostume off, and no second costume goes over it. Using a Reindeer Suit (Christmas_Reindeer_Suit) puts it on the player who used it. Its picture on the buff bar is the game's stag. Duration is in seconds; the suit's description in items.lang writes it out (30:00), so change it with this.
Name: christmas.mmo.effect.christmas_costume_reindeer_suit.name
